auditor.agent: i18n-auditor subagents, one fresh session per round; none translated or edited any value they judged
auditor.model: anthropic/claude-opus-5-5, as reported by each session's selected_model and model_id in its transcript; no provider fallback observed
auditor.independence: Each round's auditor session differs from the translator lane (f0a2d7ee0d2e, anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5), from the remediation translator session(s), and from the previous round's auditor. Translators and auditors share the Claude model family (disclosed).

source_audit_revision: origin/main as read by each auditor through git show/cat-file on the audit day; the exact commit was not recorded by the sessions
current_report_verdict: PASS (locale-wide, round 2): BLOCKER 0 · MAJOR 0 · MINOR 1 · NIT 3 (96 changed keys judged; 0 declined; 28/28 round-1 findings addressed); this namespace: 0 finding(s) over 2 round(s), final round 0 blocker / 0 major / 0 minor / 0 nit
limitations: Independent LLM review, not native-speaker certification. Open native-speaker review items are listed in the PR body (ambiguous.txt).

Scalar text evidence only (values, ICU argument/plural structure, terminal-cell counts computed by the auditors' own scripts). No terminal, RTL or device frame was rendered, so this is not rendered-layout proof.
The audit sessions were read-only and ran no repo validator; scripts/i18n/check.py, generate.py --check and the i18n tests were run later by the applier against these exact bytes (see the PR).

The sessions recorded their work in findings.jsonl, progress.log and summary.md rather than a shell log; audit.log here carries those records verbatim plus the applier's computed hashes, and no command output is invented.
Ledger rows were authored by script per docs/I18N.md because core has no ledger writer; hashes are computed from file bytes.
audited_input_binding: Bound by the committed per-key manifest in input_paths.audited_input_manifest (file sha256 in input_hashes); tests/unit/i18n/test_audit_input_manifests.py recomputes every entry from the shipped catalogue. The former out-of-tree scratchpad file hash was dropped because no reader could re-hash it.
